commands.arg1: You need to specify what time you would like to set it to!
commands.notEnabled: TimeChanger is not enabled! Enable it with /time set <time>.

help.line1: /time set <time> (time can be "day", "night", "sunset" or a custom time)

commands.cycleOn: Force Daylight Cycle is now ON.
commands.cycleOff: Force Daylight Cycle is now OFF.

picker.title: Choose your sky
picker.cycleSpeed: 0.001–100×. 1× is normal; lower values slow time down.
picker.durationHint: Estimate at 20 time updates per second. Pauses and different update rates affect duration.
picker.invalidTime: Enter a whole number of ticks.
picker.saveFailed: Could not save settings. Your changes are active; saving will be retried.
picker.serverHint: Following server time. Select Fixed or Cycling to choose your sky.
picker.fixedHint: Your sky stays at the selected time. Changes apply immediately.
picker.cyclingHint: Your sky advances from the selected time while in a world.
picker.timelineHint: Drag to choose time. Arrow keys: 100 ticks. Home: sunrise. End: 23900 ticks.

mode.serverDescription: Follow server time; turn off the time override.
mode.fixedDescription: Keep the sky at your selected time.
mode.cyclingDescription: Advance the daylight cycle from your selected time.
